card.name: Soap and skin-product lists
card.fires_on: Commas, 'or', 'and' and verbs like 'using' right after skin-care products such as scented soaps, shampoos, cleansers or cosmetics. Also fires on endings of topical gel names.

modes.label: Lists of skin products
modes.description: Comma or linking word inside a list of soaps, shampoos, lotions or cosmetics.

modes.label: Using less often
modes.description: The verb 'using' after rinsing off a skin product sooner, in dryness advice.
